headline: JBM Ecolife Mobility secures ₹750 crore hybrid investment from Motilal Oswal Alternates
sum: JBM Ecolife Mobility (subsidiary of JBM Auto Ltd) secured ₹750 crore long-term strategic growth capital from Motilal Oswal Alternates' India Credit Excellence Fund-I, structured as a combination of structured debt and equity-linked securities. The capital will fund deployment of ~2,000 additional electric buses, scaling the company's fleet from 3,400 to ~5,000 buses within 12 months, and represents the largest investment by an Indian investor in the electric mobility sector to date.
implication: Hybrid debt-equity private credit architecture validates long-term concession-based cash flow model for green infrastructure; demonstrates emerging Indian alternative fund appetite for contract-backed bus fleet operations competing with IFC/multilateral funding.
detail: The transaction closed in June 2026 and was structured through Motilal Oswal Alternates' India Credit Excellence Fund-I (ICEF-I), combining structured debt and equity-linked securities to provide growth capital. The capital will support acquisition, operation and deployment of zero-emission e-buses under long-term agreements with state transport authorities. JBM Ecolife currently operates approximately 3,400 buses across multiple Indian states and has a consolidated order book exceeding 10,000 buses (deployed and under execution). The company operates one of the world's largest dedicated integrated electric bus manufacturing facilities outside China in Delhi-NCR with annual production capacity of 20,000 buses. MO Alternates emphasized JBM's market leadership, proven execution, long-term concession structures offering predictable contract-backed cash flows, and alignment with national initiatives including PM e-Bus Sewa Programme, PM e-Drive initiative and PM Gati Shakti.
